'''''Fan Faire 2009 Commemorative Painting''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] made during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It had [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and Warren Wicket on it, as well as the words "Galactic Gathering 2009."

==Behind the scenes==
It was given out to the players who attended the summit in 2009. It is flagged as a no trade item.
